gold.user: As a user, I want to retrieve a list of all existing relations in the Directus database so that I can understand how different collections are linked together.
gold.ideal: The response should include an array of relation objects, each containing details such as the relation type, source collection, and target collection.

gold.user: As a user, I want to create a new relation between two collections in Directus so that I can establish a connection between them for data integrity.
gold.ideal: The response should return the newly created relation object with its unique identifier and the details of the relation.

gold.user: As a user, I want to fetch the details of a specific relation by its ID so that I can review its configuration and properties.
gold.ideal: The response should provide the relation object corresponding to the given ID, including all relevant attributes.

gold.user: As a user, I want to update an existing relation's properties to reflect changes in the data model so that it remains accurate and functional.
gold.ideal: The response should return the updated relation object with the modified attributes.

gold.user: As a user, I want to delete a specific relation by its ID to remove unnecessary connections and clean up the database schema.
gold.ideal: The response should confirm the deletion of the relation, ideally returning a success message or status.
